rationale: C16 supplies both principal designation clauses of the child in nearly verbatim form: the operative grant of privileges under the International Organizations Immunities Act and the distinctive proviso preserving privileges acquired by treaty or congressional action. C22 and C25 contain the same machinery and proviso, but C16 is the closest concise two-paragraph drafting template. The child's additional treatment of the Pan American Union is target-specific.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I hereby designate such organization as a public international organization entitled to enjoy the privileges, exemptions, and immunities conferred by the International Organizations Immunities Act.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hereby designate such Commission as a public international organization entitled to enjoy the privileges, exemptions, and immunities conferred by the said International Organizations Immunities Act.
shared_material.explanation: Nearly verbatim operative designation language, with only the entity reference and a minor article changed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The designation of the Organization of American States as a public international organization within the meaning of the International Organizations Immunities Act is not intended to abridge in any respect privileges, exemptions, and immunities which the Organization may have acquired or may acquire by treaty or congressional action.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The designation of the South Pacific Commission as a public international organization within the meaning of the said International Organizations Immunities Act is not intended to abridge in any respect privileges, exemptions, and immunities which such organization may have acquired or may acquire by treaty or congressional action.
shared_material.explanation: The distinctive savings clause is reproduced almost word for word and adapted only to the new organization.
